newsitem.title: UK: LPC - Morland increases loan to fund buys.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Morland increases loan to fund buys.

text.p: LONDON, January 23 (LPC) - UK brewer and pub owner Morland has extended an existing credit facility to 33.5 million stg to part finance its acquisition of 24 restaurants and 16 pubs, according to Morland's Finance Director, Paul Rivers.
Morland announced on Thursday the acquisition of 24 Exchange bar restaurants from Allied Domecq for 32 million stg and the 16 pubs from Whitbread for a of 3.4 million stg.

Arranged by Kleinwort Benson, the term loan is priced at 35 bps over LIBOR plus adjustments which brings pricing to around 40 bps over LIBOR. The credit matures in October 2000. The loan will not be syndicated.
The original medium term loan was taken out for 8.5 million stg. The increase brings Morland's total bank credits to 76 million stg.
Morland also plans to raise 22.2 million stg through a one- for-six rights issue of 4.67 million new ordinary shares at a price of 500p per share.
